Complete. All required science was saved before native Goal terminal completion, ~23 minutes ahead of the 19:32:48Z deadline.

Top finding: the thin plan's mechanisms point the right way but are unsafe as stated — P1/P2 grant extensions ambient host authority (child process + raw paths is not a sandbox), P4's overwrite breaks undo/provenance, and P5's silent auto-update contradicts reproducibility. The draft corrects each with deny-by-default boundaries, an OpenRefine-style operation log, and pinned gated upgrades.

Artifacts in `/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M09-A/control/research/`:

- `source-map.json` (14 immutable sources, valid JSON) + `sources/` index with 14 bounded excerpts
- `plan-reveal.json` + `revealed-plan.md` (gate records)
- `draft.md` (18,934 bytes, self-contained, exact per-P dispositions: P1/P2/P3/P4 correction, P5 rejected, P6 expanded; V1–V7 validations separated executed vs proposed)

Method notes: no plan/campaign/counterpart/evaluator reads before reveal; writes confined to the allowed root; no code executed (no qualified sandbox — honestly recorded, all behavioral checks proposed as V1–V7); no nested agents.
